actual_execution.exec_command_cmd:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = 'C:/Users/35326/Desktop/postgraduation/0/Mcode/drone_tcn/DL1018'
$exp = Join-Path $root 'experiments/position_axis_coordinate_c5_20261023'
$report = Join-Path $root 'reports/paper_continuation_20261023/c5_axis_coordinate_execution'
$releasePath = Join-Path $exp 'C5_FIRST_PARENT_RELEASE_v1.json'
$release = Get-Content -LiteralPath $releasePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$launcher = Join-Path $exp 'RUN_C5_FIRST_EXACT_v1.ps1'
$stdout = Join-Path $report 'C5_FIRST_STDOUT_v1.txt'
$stderr = Join-Path $report 'C5_FIRST_STDERR_v1.txt'
$commandRecord = Join-Path $report 'C5_FIRST_COMMAND_v1.txt'
$exitRecord = Join-Path $report 'C5_FIRST_SCENE_MATLAB_OS_EXIT_v1.json'
$receipt = Join-Path $report 'C5_FIRST_EXECUTION_RECEIPT_v1.json'
$pref = $release.execution_environment.MATLAB_PREFDIR
$targets = @($stdout,$stderr,$commandRecord,$exitRecord,$receipt)
$existing = @($targets | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ })
if ($existing.Count) { throw "Refusing run; pre-existing output(s): $($existing -join ', ')" }
if ($release.state -ne 'APPROVED_C5_FIRST_SCENE_V1' -or $release.plant_authorized -ne $true -or $release.max_new_Plant -ne 1 -or $release.scene_id -ne 'DL1018_VAL_T2_C00_W10') { throw 'Parent release authorization fields mismatch.' }
$processes = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(MATLAB|matlab)(\.exe)?$' })
if ($processes.Count) { throw "Refusing run; MATLAB already active: $($processes | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" }
$free = [int64](Get-PSDrive -Name C).Free
if ($free -lt [int64]$release.minimum_free_bytes) { throw "Refusing run; free bytes below release minimum: $free" }
$checks = @(
  @{ Path = $releasePath; Sha = '6feeb676700a7ec5858d93687bd1f36480af2c2d304d4b0f2e7e71c5f3bae588' },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'C5_AXIS_COORDINATE_INPUT_LOCK_v1.json'); Sha = $release.c5_input_lock_sha256 },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'C5_SOURCE_BINDING_v1.json'); Sha = $release.c5_source_binding_sha256 },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'C5_AXIS_COORDINATE_RUN_CONTRACT_v1.json'); Sha = $release.c5_run_contract_sha256 },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'C5_AXIS_COORDINATE_PREPARE_RESULT_v1.json'); Sha = $release.c5_prepare_result_sha256 },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'C5_AXIS_COORDINATE_PREPARED_CFG_OPTS_v1.mat'); Sha = $release.c5_snapshot_sha256 },
  @{ Path = $launcher; Sha = $release.first_launcher_sha256 },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'run_c5_axis_coordinate_v1.m'); Sha = $release.c5_runner_sha256 },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'run_dl1018_closed_loop.m'); Sha = '48350037b66efe00301b138068f187c62cf92583f0f9ba2fabc9b24f248a963c' },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'delayed_prediction_step_candidate.m'); Sha = '48feebf934b8eb90b4424f2286aa857c48213d229714f30af99aacf53329549d' },
  @{ Path = (Join-Path $exp 'run_episode_dl1018.m'); Sha = 'fcc1f5de659541e692483f8395d93fd2a251256286ebade5e510ed4c7a2e2330' }
)
$hashes = foreach ($item in $checks) {
  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $item.Path)) { throw "Missing release-bound file: $($item.Path)" }
  $h = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $item.Path).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  if ($h -ne $item.Sha.ToLowerInvariant()) { throw "SHA mismatch for $($item.Path): $h expected $($item.Sha)" }
  [pscustomobject]@{ path=$item.Path; sha256=$h }
}
$tokens = $null; $parseErrors = $null
[void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($launcher,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$parseErrors)
if ($parseErrors.Count) { throw "Launcher parse error: $($parseErrors | Out-String)" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pref -Force | Out-Null
$commandText = "`$env:MATLAB_PREFDIR = '$pref'`r`n& '$launcher'`r`n"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $commandRecord -Value $commandText -NoNewline -Encoding utf8
$commandSha = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $commandRecord).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
[pscustomobject]@{ status='PREFLIGHT_PASS'; freeBytes=$free; freeGiB=[math]::Round($free/1GB,2); releaseSha256=$release.c5_source_binding_sha256; launcherParser='PASS'; commandSha256=$commandSha; bindings=$hashes } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
$env:MATLAB_PREFDIR = $pref
& $launcher 1> $stdout 2> $stderr
